# SMAA source

Vendored from `iryoku/smaa` at commit
`71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d` (2026-10-10).

`SMAA.hlsl` is the authors' SMAA shader. `AreaTex.h` and `SearchTex.h` are
the precomputed lookup tables required by SMAA 1x. See `LICENSE.txt` for the
upstream MIT license and its clarification for binary distributions.

Upstream: https://github.com/iryoku/smaa
